source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of evaluating sources (PDF 185).

blocks.text: Maloomat ke maakhaz parakhna batata hai ke maloomat durust aur qabil-e-bharosa hai ya nahi. Is mein maakhaz, us ka aitbaar, data ki provenance, kya yeh primary source hai, tanqeedi soch, khatre ki alamaat aur tarafdari samajhna shamil hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: teen column, digital divide ki wajoohat (maali, jughrafiyai, taleemi, samaji), asraat (taleem, rozgar, shehri zindagi, sehat, digital khwandagi) aur pul (Universal Service Fund, khwandagi programme, shirakatein), teeron se jure. Neeche baen: maakhaz parakhne ki saat nukaati checklist. Neeche daen: achhe digital shehri ki aadatein.
blocks.caption: Digital divide, maakhaz ki parakh aur digital citizenship (topics 7.3 se 7.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Digital divide laagat, dehi networks ki kami, kam digital maharat aur umar, jins aur maazoori jaisi samaji rukawaton se paida hota hai; yeh taleem, rozgar, shehri shirakat, sehat aur digital khwandagi ke faasle barhata hai; aur Universal Service Fund jaise sarkari mansoobon, khwandagi programmes aur public-private shirakaton se kam kiya ja sakta hai. Maloomat par bharose se pehle dekhein ke kis ne shaya ki, us ka ikhtiyar, data ka maakhaz, kya yeh primary source hai, doosre nuqta-e-nazar, khatre ki alamat aur tarafdari. Achha digital shehri mazboot passwords rakhta, mashkook links se bachta, data ehtiyat se share karta, copyright ka ehtaram karta, privacy settings istemal karta, mil kar kaam karta aur mawad ko qabil-e-rasai banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Maloomat ke maakhaz parakhne ke aham qadam kya hain (short question 5)?
blocks.explanation: Dekhein ke maloomat kis ne shaya ki (source evaluation); likhne wala mahir ya ikhtiyar wala hai ya nahi (credibility); data kahan se aaya aur kaise badla (provenance); asal hai ya khulasa (primary ya secondary); kai maakhaz aur nuqta-e-nazar milayein (critical thinking); khatre ki alamaat jaise naam ke baghair ya sansani khez surkhiyan dekhein; aur tarafdari talash karein.

items: Maakhaz parkhein: source, credibility, provenance, primary ya nahi, critical thinking, red flags, bias.
